outcomes.text: Tell an issue from a perspective and consider viewpoints objectively and with empathy.
Plan and carry out research into a global issue and use evidence to support claims.
Identify arguments and judge the evidence and reasoning behind claims.
Judge sources and research processes, spotting bias, opinion, fact, claim, prediction, value and vested interest.

subtopics.title: Line of reasoning and courses of action

outcomes.text: Build a line of reasoning for a perspective or evidence-based course of action, with sustainability in mind.
Justify a personal perspective and reflect on how research and teamwork shaped learning.
Present arguments and evidence clearly with citations and references.
Write a structured research report on a global issue of own choice.
Work in a team on a local issue and plan, act and reflect.
